<subject>Re: Corporate Secretary Replacement</subject>
<body>
We will miss you also.  Glad we had you for the time we did.  See you at the Board meeting.
 
Hugh
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: Bailey, Ann
Sent: Thursday, 7 November 2024 19:25
To: Cole, Elliot; Russell, Kirsty
Subject: Corporate Secretary Replacement


As you guys probably know, I will be officially retired on 31 December 2024; therefore, the meeting on 11 November will be my last and a good time to elect my successor.  Thanks for letting me continue as your corporate secretary after stepping down from that position at Halcyon Mutual Bank.  I don't think I could have let go "cold turkey," and I loved working with the team at Northern Financial Services because of my fondness for the directors and most of the management.  (I'll reserve comments on some members of management who are no longer with us.)  I have really enjoyed it since Hugh-the-Man got involved, and the morale and operating results show how positive that was for the company.  I have also been a long time admirer of Britannia Investment Group and loved working with Oliver Leonard.  So, it is my hope and sincere recommendation that Oliver be selected to succeed me.  He has demonstrated repeatedly that he is capable of doing the job -- in fact, he has been doing the job for a long time, all except the actual taking of the minutes, and he has relieved me of that duty on more than one occasion.  He's a person of integrity, loyalty, and dedication, and I know the Directors like him.  I hope you two agree. 
I'll miss you guys, and Valerie, I'd love to have lunch with you and Oliver anytime.  I'll also be available for any help and advice that I can give.
Thanks again.
Much love, Kathryn Archer
</quoted>
